blocos.texto: The blessing comes in two forms: Yin, which grants prosperity, and Yang, which grants strength.

The game starts with the Yin blessing, which alternates every four minutes of play. The icon to the right of the divine power bar displays the Yin or Yang icon and a circular meter that indicates the time remaining for the exchange.
When you hover the cursor over the icon, the active bonus and remaining time are displayed in text. Additionally, a sound plays and a notification appears when the blessing changes.

In Favorable Terrain: Foundations are built automatically.
Buildings spread Favorable Terrains with +1 greater range.
:aomr_creators_auspice_icon: Under the Aegis of the Creator
This divine blessing has different levels of benefits. Players start at Level 0 and reach higher levels permanently, each accessed based on accumulated favor thresholds.

There is on the accumulated favor limit, so favor spent or accumulated makes on the difference. The favor is not spent on access levels; Levels are unlocked instantly when the player reaches the required favor limits.
In most cases, players can reach Level 1 in Classic Age :aomr_classical_age_icon:, while the other levels are not easily attainable and require considerable time and expansion.
The discount only applies to Peasants :aomr_peasant_icon:, not Kuafus :aomr_kuafu_icon: or Kuafu Hero :aomr_kuafu_hero_icon:.

Hovering the cursor over the :aomr_creators_auspice_icon: Creator's Auspex icon on the right side of the divine power toolbar displays the current bonuses and the amount of favors needed to reach the next level.

blocos.texto: As the game begins, a random :aomr_type_myth_unit_icon: mythic unit is selected from the next Age to be spawned by Shennong's Boon of the Beasts divine blessing.

This unit is any :aomr_type_myth_unit_icon: mythical unit that can normally be trained in the :aomr_temple_icon: Temple of any Chinese major god, even if the player has not Age evolved with it or even if it is only granted by a minor god that Shennong does not have access to. Once chosen, its resource cost is transformed into Reward Points using the formula:
From the moment the mythical unit :aomr_type_myth_unit_icon: is chosen, as the player generates favor :favoraom:, the same amount of Reward Points calculated by the formula above is reduced.

When it reaches zero, the mythical unit :aomr_type_myth_unit_icon: is generated for free in the player's Temple :aomr_temple_icon:. The unit is generated even if the player has no more population space available. After a unit is generated, the game randomly chooses the next mythical unit to be generated.

This way, the player can gain access to mythic units from the Classical Age :aomr_classical_age_icon: in the Archaic Age :aomr_archaic_age_icon:, mythic units from the Heroic Age :aomr_heroic_age_icon: in the Classical Age :aomr_classical_age_icon:, and mythic units :aomr_type_myth_unit_icon: from the Mythic Age :aomr_mythic_age_icon: in the Heroic Age :aomr_heroic_age_icon:, Mythic Age :aomr_mythic_age_icon:, and the Wonder Ages :aomr_wonder_age_icon:.
By hovering over the Boon of Beasts :aomr_shennong_gift_all: icon on the right side of the divine power toolbar, you can view the next mythical unit and the remaining Reward Points to generate it.
If the player does not have a :aomr_temple_icon: Temple, the Reward Points of the chosen mythical unit are reduced until they reach 1, at which point the mechanism is paused.

Once a :aomr_temple_icon: Temple is built, the unit spawns and the next unit is chosen. Therefore, any favor :favoraom: obtained between the time the Reward Point reached 1 and the time the Temple was built does not contribute to reducing the next unit's Reward Points.
